headline: Cleaner session picker
pill: the session picker shows what you actually asked
summary: Continuing a Claude Code or Codex session is easier: the picker shows the question you asked in each session instead of context the CLIs add behind the scenes, and it closes when you click elsewhere.
fixes: Session titles no longer show IDE context such as `<ide_opened_file>` or CLI-added blocks; they show the first thing you typed, without Markdown symbols or stray backslashes.
The session picker closes when you click outside it or press Esc.
The Conversations view's empty message showed a literal `\n`; its link is now a proper button.
improvements: Each session in the picker shows its tool and age on one line, so long titles no longer push them out of view.
The Marketplace page now has screenshots and a full feature overview.
